summary: Diagnose recurring communication failures in agent conversations and stage the smallest durable corrections for approval.

scenarios.title: Review a frustrating project task
scenarios.prompt: Use the agent-self-improve skill to review this project's recent tasks. Focus on why the agent kept asking questions the repository already answered.
scenarios.outcome: A diagnosis tied to conversation evidence and numbered, approval-gated edits for the narrowest guidance layer.

scenarios.title: Evaluate a supplied transcript
scenarios.prompt: Use the agent-self-improve skill on this transcript and explain whether the failure came from execution, a skill, or project instructions.
scenarios.outcome: A scoped cause analysis that does not blame prompt wording or edit agent configuration without approval.
